entities.summary: Taeyang (b. 1988-05-18, Uijeongbu) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Uijeongbu and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, composers & musicians, asia.
